newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United Wisconsin raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United Wisconsin raised.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said it upgraded United Wisconsin Services Inc to buy from outperform based on increasing profitability in the company's American Medical Security unit.
-- said raised the rating based on "high degree of confidence" that the medical membership of the company's American Medical Security unit will turn to profitability by the first quarter of 1998.
-- said the earnings estimates of $1.31 a share for 1997 and $2.06 a share in 1998 remain unchanged, but "we believe that our projections remain conservative."
-- said price target remains $44 in 12-18 months.
